Name: Sinister Servants - Trinkets
Author: mushymato
Description:
Contest Mod entry for 2024 Spirit's Eve event, adds 6 new trinkets to the game.

[b][size=5]New Trinkets[/size][/b]
These trinkets do not replace any vanilla trinkets, instead they are entirely new items. Most of these can be upgraded on the anvil, and some have different appearances that can be accessed via the trinket colorizer.

[size=3]How to obtain:[/size]
[spoiler]
Once you unlock combat mastery, a new vendor appears up in quarry mines entrance and sells trinkets as from this mod in exchange for monster drops (they are fairly expensive).

The trinket colorizer is also sold here for changing the appearance of certain trinkets, and on spirit's eve, you can directly purchase variant trinkets from the shop.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730591478-796447948.png[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Polished Cranium[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730583883-72755774.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730583920-1155837111.png[/img]

Summon a haunted skull that orbits around you and deal damage to nearby enemies, with high knockback.

[list]
[*]Lv.2: Hits deal 20-30 damage
[*]Lv.3: Hits deal 30-40 damage
[*]Lv.4: Hits deal 40-50 damage
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730585391-11980843.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Leathery Wing[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730585645-873072010.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730585651-695360099.png[/img]

Summon a bat that perches on your head sometimes, recover HP and Energy when you land a critical hit.

[list]
[*]Lv.1: On critical hit, recover 13 HP and 13 Energy
[*]Lv.2: On critical hit, recover 13% of the damage dealt as HP and Energy.
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730585870-923400089.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Sticc[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730587207-333953268.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730587208-1736720336.png[/img]

Summon a stick bug that harvests nearby forage or crops, also harvest things from trees and bushes.

[list]
[*]Lv.1: Harvest nearby forage, recover 44 HP on success. Shake and harvests trees and bushes.
[*]Lv.2: Harvest nearby crops, recover 44 Energy on success. Shake and harvests trees and bushes.
[*]Lv.3: Harvest nearby forage and crops, recover 44 HP and Energy on success. Shake and harvests trees and bushes.
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730587227-1075507645.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Fuzzy Coal[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730589036-574286550.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730589328-1901662521.png[/img]

Summon 3 dust spirits, very bouncy. They break nearby rocks and give an attack buff when they do so. Also shakes nearby trees and bushes.

[list]
[*]Lv.1: Every 10s, break one nearby rock and grant +20 attack. Shakes nearby trees and bushes.
[*]Lv.2: Every 2s, break one nearby rock and grant +5 attack. Shakes nearby trees and bushes.
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730589115-1131935129.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Tiny Spider[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730588375-520619031.gif[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730588327-1233177097.png[/img]

Summon a hopping spider, shoots web that immobilise an enemy.

[list]
[*]Lv.1: Shoot web every 5s, immobilise for 3s.
[*]Lv.2: Shoot web every 8s, immobilise for 6s.
[*]Lv.3: Shoot web every 11s, immobilise for 10s.
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730588332-1123203893.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Jug of Iridium Milk[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730590187-1218261700.gif[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730590190-1750772060.png[/img]

Summon an iridium snake, seek out and explode enemies every 3s for 77 damage. It costs 7 HP per attack, and the explosion can damage the player.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/29074/29074-1730590188-1204491754.gif[/img]
[/spoiler]



[b][size=5]Translations[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]
More translations are welcome, either integrated into the mod or as separate posting.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/ContentPatcher]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url]
[*]Install this mod.
[/list]
